purpose: Create an auditable, label-free, single-machine shadow comparison for the already-developed C0 model against the active T2 incumbent. This is not an evaluation, promotion, production replacement, or trading authorization.

governance.candidate_definition: The exact WP09 heteroscedastic proportional-odds algorithm, fixed 14 RG3 location features, fixed three scale features, fixed regularizers and fixed calibration grid. Artifact materialization may serialize this already-defined candidate but may not search, tune, alter features, alter parameters, select a seed, or read a WP10 output.
governance.wp10_boundary: FAIL_CLOSED_FRESH_EVIDENCE_TAINTED_BY_SECOND_LABEL_READ_RETAIN_INCUMBENT. No WP10 label, target, metric, prediction, result, calibration, or conclusion may be read by a WP11 process or used to set any WP11 choice.

shadow.input_quality_rule: A stock may enter a hypothetical paper universe only when source_trade_date equals origin_date, all 14 technical features are finite, and all three class probabilities are finite and sum to one. Every other row is retained only for audit.

candidate_contract.calibration: fixed expanding TRAIN-only calibration grid from WP09; selection rule is unchanged

future_evaluation.primary_ic_rule: Maintain the WP09 300-valid-stock threshold. It may not be reduced on the basis of WP10 observations. A week below 300 is reported as not evaluable and cannot support promotion.
required_before_authorization: all future inputs and predictions sealed
new target-construction source and SHA-locked daily snapshot audited
candidate and incumbent key coverage validated

resource_policy.cpu: Feature construction, hashing, C0 artifact materialization, and all shadow inference use two CPU threads.
resource_policy.gpu: No GPU task is started by WP11. GPU remains available for a separately preregistered, unclosed future research candidate only.
resource_policy.heavy_jobs: At most one heavy job at a time.
